reviews.reasoning: I found none of the listed unsupported constructs. The detection has two selections (QueryName endswith/startswith, Image endswith), all modifiers are in the allowed set, and the fields are valid for dns_query. The only candidate is 'condition: 1 of them'. That is the same 'N of' quantifier the contract allows ('1 of selection*'), and both selections here start with 'selection', so it is equivalent. It is not on the contract's NOT-allowed list (count, near, timeframe, aggregation, correlation). By hand, the rule matches all 3 positives and none of the negatives or look-alikes (nhagent.exe with nh-status does not match, because the second selection requires Image \svchelper.exe).
incidental_issues: The contract literally quotes only '1 of selection*' and 'all of selection*'. A strict reading of 'them' as a different keyword could make this a borderline case, which is why confidence is only moderate.
This rule looks like a within-subset control, not a seeded defect.
'nh-' is only 3 characters, which may matter for G4 or G11 but does not affect G3.
